geometry_source: V0.2 polygons retained without coordinate changes.
method: Shoelace area on SVG polygon vertices; pairwise overlap tested using segment intersection and point-in-polygon; frame containment tested against x=100..1700 and y=120..850.
presentation_changes: Removed the equator label and dashed equator line because globe orientation and latitude are not yet established.
Clarified that the grid is illustrative and does not encode validated coordinates.
Updated title, versioning and status notes.
limitations: This is a presentation cleanup, not a coastline-shape redesign.
Canvas-area shares are not geodesic planetary land-area shares.
No plate-containment or projection validation has been performed.
